newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga to launch islandwide food production drive on December 12; government to take over uncultivated lands.
Tamil rebels kill 14 civilians, all but two executed for being alleged army informants, in Jaffna peninsula in last four months.
Police sieze truck with secret compartment used to smuggle arms and explosives into Colombo.

Former senior army officer ordered Rohana Wijeweera, leader of Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna leftwing rebel group, to be killed and incinerated at Borellla cemetery, military police soldier in prison says in affidavit to attorney-general.
Navy kills six Tamil Tiger guerrillas in attack on rebel trawler off northern Jaffna peninsula.
